MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The assorted heat shrink tubing felt useful alongside my existing spade connectors because it would help insulate wiring repairs across several wire sizes.",
    "The waterproof crimp connectors matched my electrical repair interests and offered a practical benefit for connections exposed to moisture."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The large cable sleeve and exact-size metric screws require a specific fit that my past purchases do not establish.",
    "Cutting wheels, woodworking tape, and a powered valve assume tools or projects I have not shown a need for, while the COVID test does not connect to my current repair shopping.",
    "Adhesives are relevant to my repair interests, but ten tubes of super glue exceed my current needs. The solder seal connectors are also relevant, but overlap with the crimp assortment I would choose now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying repair supplies seems to have been taken as a reason to recommend accessories for many unrelated repair projects.",
    "My hose clamps and tape purchases seem to have been stretched into interest in powered plumbing equipment and specialized woodworking tape, despite their different uses."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility matters: assorted insulation and familiar connector types are easier to justify than a fixed screw size or a large cable sleeve without a known application.",
    "I choose supplies for a concrete need. Similar wiring products can substitute for one another, and a relevant adhesive can still be an unsuitable purchase when the quantity is excessive."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical wiring and repair interests but assumed too many specialized projects and overlooked fit, quantity, and overlapping uses."
}
